title: 第11章 曾经的属下第12章 把整个世界都放下了去巡夜司
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
夜洐漠不关心的离去。
俏寡妇眼中光芒再次黯淡下去，满是无力与绝望。
“原来是怂人。”不敢出头的看客们，不妨碍他们心中鄙视嘲讽夜洐。
“还以为遇到惹不起的人，原来装腔作势，吓死老子了。”光头壮汉没了谨小慎微。
他的手下，尤其刚才被光头踢飞的小弟，不敢找老大的麻烦，于是盯上了夜洐，刚要说些狠话。
话还未出口。
一道神秘的人影站在他身后，戴着斗篷。
一股刺骨的杀气，似潮水从身后弥漫开来，饼炉中火光暗淡几分，渗人的寒意令周围人鸦雀无声。
“大.....大人....”光头等地痞们，惊恐又谄谀看着神秘人。
带着斗篷是杀人寇，刚刚收集一些情报而来。
“滚开。”
“是是是。”光头等人麻溜的滚开，不敢挡路。
不敢招惹眼前神秘的绝世凶人。
热闹的街道静默无声，在杀人寇不加掩饰的杀气下，早已经冷汗直流。
“不知道哪里来的绝世凶人，气势太可怕。”
大家看着杀人寇的背影，害怕又好奇。
“那个怂人居然不让路，这不是找死吗？”
大家看到，杀人寇径直走向夜洐。
下一刻。
他们眼中的绝世凶人，站在夜洐身后，弯着腰，低声说些什么。

听不到说的是什么。
但态度能感觉出，很敬畏。
“这......”大家目瞪口呆，怀疑自己看错了。
揉了揉眼睛，的确弯着腰，哪还有刚才绝世凶人的气势，反而像忠心的仆人。
“大人，查了下，城主府，巡夜司，城中一些世家，歌舞升平，外紧内松，没有特别情况。”杀人寇汇报自己调查的情况。
“怨鬼也传来消息，没查出隐龙城近段时间有特殊的人物到来。”
“城外的白骨夫人暂时没发现异样。”
“可以确定旱灾非天灾，非妖魔作乱。”夜洐现在已经可以确定了，从隐龙城各方势力反应而言，根本没有妖魔。
城外白骨夫人没传来消息。
就是答案。
城外没有隐藏势力。
“城主应当第四境，隐龙城各大世家应该有一两位四境人物。”夜洐回忆自己所了解的隐龙城高层战力。
四境已经是隐龙城的最强者。
“巡夜司什么情况。”夜洐最重视的就是巡夜司，目标也是巡夜司。
“巡夜司很神秘，几乎没消息传出来，怨鬼在暗中观察，暂时不知内部情况，但发现两位巡夜司成员正在酒楼喝酒。”
“带路。”
content_en:
Ye Xi left indifferently.
The light in the pretty widow's eyes dimmed again, full of powerlessness and despair.
"Turns out he is a coward." The onlookers who did not dare to speak out did not prevent them from despising Ye Hao in their hearts.
"I thought that when I met someone I couldn't afford to offend, it turned out that I was so pretentious that I was scared to death." The bald man lost all caution.
His men, especially the younger brother who had been kicked away by Baldhead just now, did not dare to cause trouble to the boss, so they focused on Ye Hui and were about to say some cruel words.
The words have not yet been spoken.
A mysterious figure stood behind him, wearing a cloak.
A biting murderous aura spread from behind like a tide. The firelight in the cake oven dimmed a bit, and the penetrating chill made everyone around him fall into silence.
"Sir...Sir..." The bald-headed and other local gangsters looked at the mysterious man in horror and flattery.
Wearing a cloak is a murderer who has just come to collect some information.
"Go away."
"Yes, yes." Baldhead and the others rolled away, not daring to block the way.
Don't dare to provoke the mysterious and unique murderer in front of you.
The bustling streets were silent, and the murderers were already sweating profusely under the undisguised murderous intent.
"I don't know where this peerless vicious man came from. His aura is too terrifying."
Everyone looked at the murderer's back with fear and curiosity.
"That coward actually refused to give way. Isn't he looking for death?"
Everyone saw that the murderer walked straight towards Ye Hui.
The next moment.
The peerless villain in their eyes stood behind Ye Hui, bending down and whispering something.
Couldn't hear what was said.
But the attitude can be felt, very awe.
"This..." Everyone was stunned and suspected that they had seen it wrong.
Rubbing his eyes, he was indeed bent over. He didn't have the aura of a peerless and fierce man just now, but instead looked like a loyal servant.
"Sir, after checking, the city lord's palace, the night watch department, and some aristocratic families in the city are singing and dancing, and they are tight on the outside and loose on the inside. There are no special circumstances." The murderer reported the situation of his investigation.
"The resentful ghost has also sent news that no special person has arrived in Hidden Dragon City recently."
"Mrs. Bones outside the city hasn't noticed anything strange for the time being."
"It is certain that the drought is not a natural disaster, nor is it caused by demons." Ye Hui is now certain. Judging from the reaction of all forces in Hidden Dragon City, there are no demons at all.
There was no news from Mrs. Bones outside the city.
That's the answer.
There are no hidden forces outside the city.
"The city lord should be in the fourth realm, and each major family in Hidden Dragon City should have one or two figures in the fourth realm." Ye Wei recalled what he knew about the high-level combat capabilities of Hidden Dragon City.
The four realms are already the strongest in Hidden Dragon City.
"What's going on with the Night Patrol Division?" Ye Hao paid the most attention to the Night Patrol Division, and his target was also the Night Patrol Division.
"The Night Watch Department is very mysterious, and almost no news has come out. The resentful ghosts are observing in secret, and they don't know the internal situation for the time being, but they found two members of the Night Watch Department drinking in a restaurant."
"Lead the way."
